description: List side pages attached to a landing page. Default detail='short'. Heavy JSONB (overrides/config) only at full via view_side_page.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

name: list_side_pages
